sources.quote: later came to be called Peripatetics, probably because of the existence of an ambulatory (peripatos) on the school’s

claims.text: Aristotle: giận đúng lúc, đúng mức trước bất công là đức hạnh; Khắc kỷ cho rằng giận và sợ luôn không thích đáng

sources.quote: the Stoics, and they came to the conclusion that such common emotions as anger and fear are always inappropriate. Aristotle assumes, on the contrary, not simply that these common passions are sometimes appropriate

claims.text: Epictetus nói ta không được trơ "như một pho tượng", phải giữ trọn các quan hệ (Diễn từ III.2)

sources.quote: for I ought not to be free from affects like a statue, but I ought to maintain the relations natural and acquired, as a pious man, as a son, as a father, as a citizen.

claims.text: Khắc kỷ muốn thay cảm xúc sinh từ phán đoán sai bằng cảm xúc hợp lý như niềm vui, sự thận trọng

sources.quote: the eupatheiai are the result of a rational aversion of vice and harmful things (discretion), a rational desire for virtue (willing), and a rational elation over virtue (delight).
